generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, presenting is something you will keep doing across your modules. Each seminar talk, each poster, each group presentation puts these foundations to work: decide one clear message, give it a shape, and let the slides support the talk rather than carry it.

The same habit carries into working life. Wherever you present an idea or a set of findings to an audience, clear communication is what makes it land. The skill you have started to build here is one you will use long after you graduate.
